name: puct-search
stage: dev screen (predeclared before any code runs a game)
idea: AlphaGo/AlphaZero-style tree search with selective depth on top of the tile-transformer value (Jerry 2026-11-08: 'try it but 2 turns deep might not be enough, we should selectively make tree deeper; see how alphago does it').

algorithm.tree: open-loop MCTS keyed by our own decisions only; no fixed depth: each simulation descends by PUCT until it reaches an unexpanded node, expands exactly one node, evaluates it, and backs up (AlphaGo Zero). Depth is limited only by the budget and by game end.
algorithm.selection: PUCT: argmax_a Q(a) + c_puct * P(a) * sqrt(N_parent) / (1 + N(a)), with c_puct 1.5; Q initialised for unvisited children to the parent's mean (first-play urgency = parent value); actions not legal in the current sampled pass are skipped (availability-aware, as in information-set MCTS).
algorithm.our_turn_actions: whole-turn plans: 'end now' plus the served bot's top-4 sequences (as planner_pv2_b_fix / planner_pv2_tiles); priors P = softmax over the served bot's own sequence scores, temperature 1 on the served score scale (an untrained stand-in for a policy head).
algorithm.setup_actions: at our setup settlements: the served bot's top-8 vertices by its own placement value, priors = softmax over those values; the road follows the served bot.
algorithm.environment_between_our_decisions: each simulation samples opponents' hidden hands from the card-counting belief (consistent totals) and the development deck from the remaining-card prior, rolls dice from the game RNG copy seeded per simulation, and plays every opponent decision with the served planner_offer_accept; our own non-plan decisions (robber, discards, trade answers) are the served bot's.
algorithm.leaf_value: planner_pv2_tiles' value network P(I win) on the encoder-v2 afterstate from our view (end-of-our-turn positions, the distribution it was trained on); terminal positions score 1/0.
algorithm.move_choice: most-visited root child; ties broken by Q then served order.
algorithm.budget: time-limited: 1.2 s per turn-plan decision and 1.5 s per setup decision, at least 16 simulations (if fewer complete, fall back to planner_pv2_tiles' choice and count it); reported: simulations per decision, max depth reached (our turns), mean depth of the most-visited line.

gate: +.02 paired lift over planner_pv2_tiles on each of tactical / mixed / self, 0 truncations, p95 decision <= 2 s, step max <= 2 s, turn max <= 10 s
power: alternative +.04, planning sigma .22, power .8 (as tiles-margin); check_design must admit it before any game
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any code or game. Phase 2 (only if this passes): retrain the value on positions the search visits (expert iteration), predeclared separately. Diagnostic expectation stated in advance: our value nets over-rank 'build a city' vs 'end turn' (.92 vs .56 in playouts), and deeper search can amplify such errors; the screen is the arbiter.

amendment_1_2026_11_08.reason: Pre-screen profile (scripts/puct_profile.py at 6c97f0e, no screen game played): opponent simulation is 93% of search time (served bot's offer search and robber scoring dominate), so 1.2 s often gives <16 simulations (16/48 fallbacks; one game 27/31); and priors from a softmax over raw served scores at temperature 1 are nearly one-hot, so the search mostly deepens the served move instead of comparing plans.

changes.priors: softmax over the served scores standardized within the decision (z-scores: subtract the mean, divide by the standard deviation; equal scores give a uniform prior), temperature 1; report mean prior entropy and top-prior mass per decision
changes.opponent_model_in_simulations: served bot with player-trade offers disabled inside simulations (opponents still answer offers and play everything else as served); our own non-plan decisions likewise without offers inside simulations; the real game is unchanged
changes.parallelism: root-parallel search: 4 worker processes per decision, each running the same algorithm on its own sampled worlds and simulation indices, visit counts and value sums merged at the root before the move choice; results depend only on (decision, simulation index), not on worker count, when max_simulations is set
changes.turn_cap: if a decision falls back, the fallback (planner_pv2_tiles) plays the rest of that turn without new searches; at most 4 searched decisions per turn
changes.budget: unchanged: 1.2 s per turn-plan decision, 1.5 s per setup decision, minimum 16 simulations

amendment_1_2026_11_08.gate: unchanged (+.02 over planner_pv2_tiles on every table, 0 truncations, p95 decision <= 2 s, step max <= 2 s, turn max <= 10 s); screen config experiments/puct-screen.json (260 seeds/panel) unchanged except the process cap note
amendment_1_2026_11_08.pre_screen_check: re-profile 4 seeded games vs 3 Tactical before any screen game; proceed only if fallbacks <= 10% of searched decisions, simulations p50 >= 64, and every latency gate holds in the profile; otherwise stop and report
amendment_1_2026_11_08.note: Amended 2026-11-08 before any screen game; the algorithm's idea (AlphaGo-Zero open-loop PUCT with selective depth over the tiles value) is unchanged.
